note: Literature magnetic Feshbach parameters for elastic a(B)=a_bg(1−Δ/(B−B0)) in 87Rb |1,+1>+|1,+1| (aa). Positions Bexp and theoretical elastic widths Δ from Marte et al., PRL 89, 283202 (2002) [arXiv:cond-mat/0210651v2] Table I (l=0 s-wave rows). a_bg≈100 a0 from Chin RMP Table IV. Marte Δ is listed in mG and converted to G here. Many narrow d-wave (l=2) loss peaks in Table I omitted (Δ≪0.1 mG). 85Rb has a separate broad resonance near 155 G (Claussen/Chin; not this isotope).
a_bg_ref: Chin et al., Rev. Mod. Phys. 82, 1225 (2010) Table IV — 87Rb aa a_bg=100 a0
